## In brief

We conduct large-scale population studies using Swedish health registries to investigate the prevalence, incidence, and long-term health outcomes of individuals with gender dysphoria. By linking multiple national registers, we can study health trajectories across time with high completeness and minimal recall bias.

We also develop and apply novel analytical approaches for studying care trajectories and patient pathways in Swedish healthcare registries. This work aims to characterize how individuals move through the healthcare system over time, identifying patterns in treatment sequences, healthcare utilization, and long-term outcomes.
